title: Gibbs conditioning, atypical consensus and splitting Gibbs measures on random regular graphs
summary: Given n independent Bernoulli(p) random variables X_i, i = 1, ..., n, representing the opinions of individuals connected by an underlying random k-regular graph G_n on {1, ..., n}, we show that when conditioned on an atypical empirical consensus, which is the normalized sum of X_i X_j over neighboring vertices i, j, the joint distribution of the random variables converges, as n goes to infinity, to an Ising measure on the infinite k-regular tree T^k with a specific external field that depends only on the bias parameter p, and a temperature that depends on both p and the atypical consensus…
